title: Exact rational envelope for the fixed-disc Banach check

source.scope: These outward rational bounds are distilled from the released certificate. The browser checks their exact Banach-space implications; it does not regenerate the interval enclosures that establish the bounds.

radius.role: Chosen validation radius in coefficient space.
radius.origin: Certificate parameter selected for the strict self-map and contraction check.
radius.aggregation: r = 10⁻⁶. It is an input radius, not a computed physical displacement.

Y.role: Outward bound for the first Newton step, assembled from the finite residual and omitted-residual witness.
Y.origin: Released audit: finite residual plus omitted-residual witness.
Y.aggregation: Y = Y_finite + Y_omitted, rounded outward to 159 × 10⁻¹².

Z.role: Outward linear inverse-defect bound; the released component budget is dominated by its shape-tail contribution.
Z.origin: Released audit: finite, finite-to-tail, g-tail, and p-tail inverse-defect contributions.
Z.aggregation: Z is the maximum of the four outward contributions; the p-tail bound 0.621 dominates.

C2.role: Outward bilinear bound for the quadratic part of the fixed-disc equation.
C2.origin: Released coefficient and inverse-norm bounds entering the quadratic estimate.
C2.aggregation: C₂ = α max(‖p‖/(16b), ‖U‖/(4b²)), rounded outward to 122.

C3.role: Outward trilinear bound for the cubic part of the fixed-disc equation.
C3.origin: Released inverse-norm and coefficient-radius bounds entering the cubic estimate.
